title: Add Live Lyrics to CarPlay on iOS 27 #shorts
description:
How to add live song lyrics to your CarPlay screen with iOS 27 CarPlay widgets and a custom CarPlay dashboard. Sing along to every song while you drive with synced lyrics right next to your map. CarPlay tips for drivers in the USA: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Atlanta. Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.
